transcript.content: Hello, what brings you in today?

Well, I'm here because of my eating habits. I guess what really brings me in is... well, after I do it, I just sit there looking at all the empty containers and wrappers, and I feel completely disgusted with myself. I've always tried to be a steady, in-control kind of man, you know? And doing this... it just makes me feel like I'm not that guy anymore.
After these episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?
No, I don't do that. I've never tried to make myself throw up or anything like that. I just... deal with how awful I feel afterwards.
During these episodes, do you feel unable to control how much you are eating?

Yeah, I do. It's like... once I start, it feels like the same discipline I have out on the road just shuts off completely. Even while I’m sitting there, literally telling myself, 'Magin, put the fork down,' my hand just keeps right on going back for more. I just can't seem to stop it.
How often do these episodes happen?

Well, since I've been stuck at home with this back injury, it's been happening pretty often. I'd say it's several nights most weeks. Honestly, I can't think of a single week in the last three months where I didn't have at least one of those episodes.
